Brokerage ब्रोकरेज

The fee a broker charges for executing a trade.

हिंदी में: ब्रोकरेज

ट्रेड पूरा करने के लिए ब्रोकर द्वारा लिया जाने वाला शुल्क।

How it is used in the lessons

Brokerage: the broker's fee for executing the trade.

From Stock Market Foundations

Costs include brokerage, exchange transaction charges, SEBI fees, stamp duty on the buy side, STT, and GST on some charges.

From Intraday Trading

Traders who traded more often lost more on average; brokerage, taxes and slippage alone take a large share.
